# AxiomOS vX.Y.Z

## Download

| File | Flash @ | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| `AxiomOS-Cardputer-ADV-vX.Y.Z-merged.bin` | **0x0** | Full image — use this |
| `AxiomOS-Cardputer-ADV-vX.Y.Z-app.bin` | `0x10000` | App only |

```bash
esptool --chip esp32s3 --port PORT --baud 460800 write_flash 0x0 AxiomOS-Cardputer-ADV-vX.Y.Z-merged.bin
```

Install guides: [EN](../docs/INSTALL.en.md) · [RU](../docs/INSTALL.ru.md) · [ZH](../docs/INSTALL.zh.md)
